name: Cloud Infrastructure & DataOps CI/CD
description: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for data platforms, IAM security, Docker containerization for data pipelines, Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, synthetic test data generation, and FinOps cloud cost management.

subskills.name: Cloud IAM, Service Accounts & Secret Management
subskills.description: IAM roles, least privilege policies, assume-role delegation, AWS Secrets Manager, GCP Secret Manager, and HashiCorp Vault.

subskills.name: Terraform Infrastructure as Code for Data Stacks
subskills.description: Provisioning S3/GCS buckets, Snowflake/BigQuery resources, Kafka clusters, RDS databases, Terraform state management, and reusable data modules.

subskills.name: Docker Containerization for Data Workloads
subskills.description: Multi-stage Dockerfiles for Python/Spark/dbt applications, container security, non-root users, caching dependencies, and minimizing image sizes.

subskills.name: Kubernetes for Data Engineering (Spark on K8s, Airflow)
subskills.description: Deploying data workloads on K8s, Spark-on-K8s operator, pod resource requests/limits, persistent volumes, node selectors, and spot instances.

subskills.name: CI/CD Pipelines for Data Pipelines (GitHub Actions / GitLab)
subskills.description: Automated linting (sqlfluff, ruff, black), unit test suites, staging environment promotion, dbt slim CI, and automated deployment pipelines.

subskills.name: Unit & Integration Testing for Data Pipelines
subskills.description: Writing pytest suites for data transformations, mocking databases and cloud storage with Moto/Testcontainers, and end-to-end integration tests.

subskills.name: Synthetic Data Generation & Test Fixtures
subskills.description: Generating realistic synthetic test datasets using Faker, synthetic data generators, anonymized production samples, and deterministic test fixtures.

subskills.name: Data Cloud FinOps & Cost Governance
subskills.description: Tagging cloud data assets, tracking compute/storage costs, identifying idle clusters, auto-scaling down off-hours, and FinOps budgeting.

subskills.name: Disaster Recovery, High Availability & Backups
subskills.description: Multi-region data replication, point-in-time recovery (PITR), automated database backups, RTO/RPO targets, and failover runbooks.

cv.signal: Provisioned multi-environment cloud data platform via Terraform and GitHub Actions CI/CD

linkedin.signal: AWS Certified Data Engineer or HashiCorp Terraform Associate

assessment.signal: Passes Cloud Data Infrastructure & DataOps CI/CD Assessment

junior.description: Containerizes data applications with Docker, configures GitHub Actions CI workflows, and writes pytest suites with mocks.

mid.description: Provisions data infrastructure with Terraform, manages least privilege cloud IAM security, and generates synthetic test fixtures.

senior.description: Orchestrates distributed workloads (Spark) on Kubernetes, manages FinOps cloud cost optimization, and architects multi-region disaster recovery systems.
